Multiple Indian States Announce Recruitment Drives for Thousands of Government Jobs

Several Indian states have announced recruitment drives for government positions, with the Indian Railways opening applications for 1,688 non-technical posts under the RRB NTPC UG Recruitment 2026. The application window for these positions will remain open until November 13. Separately, Uttar Pradesh is set to recruit over 12,000 assistant teachers, with the application deadline for these posts being November 4. Additionally, the UPSSSC Sports Directorate has announced vacancies for 108 positions.
